config_file.description: Path to ansible-lint config file. If empty, defaults are searched (.ansible-lint, .config/ansible-lint.yml, .config/ansible-lint.yaml).

exclude_paths.description: List of file or directory paths to exclude from linting.

rules_dir.description: List of paths to custom rule directories.

format.description: Output format: brief, full, md, json, codeclimate, quiet, pep8, sarif.

profile.description: Rule profile: min, basic, moderate, safety, shared, production.

skip_list.description: List of rule IDs or tags to skip during linting.

warn_list.description: List of rule IDs or tags to warn about instead of erroring.

enable_list.description: List of optional rule tags to activate.

write_list.description: Controls write/transform behavior: 'all', 'none', or comma-separated rule IDs/tags.

sarif_file.description: Path to SARIF output file when using --format sarif.

ignore_file.description: Path to ignore file for violations.

strict.description: If true, return non-zero exit code for warnings as well as errors.

parseable.description: If true, enable parseable (pep8) output (same as --parseable).

show_relpath.description: If true, display paths relative to current working directory.

offline.description: If true, disable installation of requirements.yml and schema refreshing.

force_color.description: If true, force colored output even without terminal support.

no_color.description: If true, disable colored output (same as NO_COLOR=1).
